confirmed_task: In psf/requests, filter to open non-draft pull requests and sort by most recently updated. Inspect the first three results. For each, report number, title, author, last-updated date, labels, changed-file count, additions, deletions, and whether any test file is included in Files changed. Rank the three by changed-file count. Stopping condition: stop after all three pull requests and their file-change summaries have been verified. Constraints: do not sign in; do not review, comment, react, merge, close, or modify pull requests; count only information GitHub displays.
